activities.name: iepHistoryTimeline

events.title: Brown v. Board of Education
events.text: Separate schooling is inherently unequal — the logic the disability cases will ride.

events.title: PARC and Mills
events.text: Two cases apply that logic to disability and win the right to public education for children with disabilities.

events.title: Education for All Handicapped Children Act
Renamed IDEA
events.text: The statute becomes the Individuals with Disabilities Education Act.

events.title: Reauthorised
events.text: IDEA reauthorised in its current form.

config.prompt: Drag between the two models of disability:

before.label: Medical
before.text: disability inside the person: the child has a deficit, and services fix or accommodate the deficit.

after.label: Social
after.text: disability in the interaction between person and environment: the wheelchair user is disabled by the stairs, not the chair — the system's job is to change the environment.

config.why: Contemporary work draws on both — structured literacy (one insight) delivered in a general classroom with accessible materials (the other) — and Universal Design for Learning is the social model operationalised.

activities.anchor: the old law's cruelty was individual malice
activities.caption: find the faulty line — why structure first
activities.name: iepStructureSpot

config.prompt: One line of this summary is wrong — click it:
lines: For most of the twentieth century, exclusion was routine: refused enrolment, institutionalisation, unregulated classes.
As late as the early 1970s, state laws explicitly authorised exclusion.
The exclusion was mostly policy — no structure required otherwise, and budgets rewarded it.
So the field's first subject is goodwill, since kindness scales better than statutes.
Goodwill is not enforceable; law is.
config.correction: The field treats structure — statutes, entitlements, due process — as its first subject, precisely because no structure required otherwise.
config.why: Policy built the exclusion, so policy — not goodwill — is what had to change.

activities.anchor: as a floor rather than a ceiling
activities.caption: true or false — what FAPE guarantees
activities.name: iepFapeJudge

statements.s: FAPE guarantees the best education the school can offer.
statements.why: It guarantees an appropriate one — reasonably calculated to enable the child to make progress.

statements.s: Courts have consistently treated that standard as the minimum, not the maximum.
statements.why: Consistently — that is the settled judicial reading.

statements.s: Much due-process litigation lives in the gap between 'appropriate' and 'optimal'.
statements.why: Which is why goals, progress data and the review cycle matter legally as well as pedagogically.

statements.s: 'Appropriate' and 'optimal' mean the same thing in litigation.
statements.why: The gap between them is where the cases live.

config.prompt: File each provision under its territory:

items.label: changes the curriculum, instruction and goals themselves
eligibility under one of thirteen recognised categories
changes how a child accesses the same curriculum
civil-rights statutes with a broader definition of disability

config.why: The professional shorthand: one plan changes how a child accesses the same curriculum; the other changes the curriculum, instruction and goals themselves.

activities.anchor: its process is a fixed cycle
activities.caption: sequence the document's making
activities.name: iepCycleOrder

config.prompt: Six moves of the meeting, in order:
items: Identification: a learner struggles, the school screens, parents consent to evaluation
A team determines eligibility under a recognised category
The IEP meeting: parents as equal team members, with teachers, an administrator and specialists
Present levels of academic achievement and functional performance written first
Annual goals, services, accommodations — and the placement
The parent's signature (or documented attempts to secure it)
config.why: Every element is individualised to this child, which is the point of the middle initial — and the signature is what turns the document into a promise.

activities.anchor: The document is a promise with a review date
activities.caption: fill the review cycle
activities.name: iepReviewCloze

config.text: Goals are tracked with data and reported to families at least as often as %%0%%; the IEP is revised at least %%1%% — more often by mutual agreement. Disagreeing families climb the safeguard ladder: informal resolution, %%2%%, due-process %%3%%, and, in egregious cases, state %%4%% systems.
config.hint: A school rhythm, a frequency, then three rungs of the ladder.

config.prompt: From parental consent, how many calendar days does federal regulation typically allow for the evaluation window (state rules vary)?
config.why: Often 60 calendar days from consent under federal regulation — and then the IEP meeting within thirty days of eligibility.
